shells.name: AIO OFFICE
shells.semantics: Internal operational office for founder / staff: operates across all clients and all services. Related to CLIENT OFFICE but not symmetrical.

shells.name: CLIENT OFFICE
shells.semantics: Authenticated client environment scoped to one client and that client’s applicable workspaces. Workspace-aware: services resolve ACTIVE · AVAILABLE_NOT_ACTIVATED · NOT_APPLICABLE.

nodes.label: AIO OFFICE
nodes.semantics: The internal operational office for founder and staff. Operates across ALL clients and ALL services. Opens on HOME.

nodes.label: HOME
nodes.semantics: Cross-business command center: what needs attention across AIO now. Projects INTAKE and WORK; owns no production state.

nodes.label: Needs Attention
nodes.semantics: Items across every client and service that need the office now. Each item opens its owning INTAKE / WORK case.
nodes.notes: The attention engine has no IFTA, bookkeeping, FleetCare or DriverLink candidates yet.

nodes.label: Deadlines
nodes.semantics: Due and upcoming dates across services (filings, renewals, expirations, permits).

nodes.label: Blockers
nodes.semantics: Work that cannot move, and why (waiting on client, missing data, failed check).
nodes.notes: No IFTA OfficeWorkItem domain; waiting-on is per client only (no cross-client rollup).

nodes.label: Work Across AIO
nodes.semantics: One line per WORK lane: open, due, blocked — each opens the lane.
nodes.notes: Today’s /office/work lists staff work items across lanes; no per-lane rollup exists.

nodes.label: Clients in Motion
nodes.semantics: Clients changing state: migrating, PREBUILT, invited, confirming, newly ACTIVE, paused. PREBUILT is never counted ACTIVE.

nodes.label: Recent Activity
nodes.semantics: Recent production events across clients and services (staff-only feed).

nodes.label: Quick Actions
nodes.semantics: Fast entry into a client or a workspace (open client, start intake, open a lane). Launches; owns nothing.

nodes.label: INTAKE
nodes.semantics: Bring clients and records into the digital AIO system: migration, extraction, matching, review, PREBUILT creation, activation invite. Staff / founder only — never in the client shell.
nodes.notes: Approved migration visual authorities (AIO_CLIENT_MIGRATION_AUTHORITY) are re-associated here — not regenerated. Lifecycle unchanged: KNOWN_UNMIGRATED … PREBUILT … ACTIVE; PREBUILT is not ACTIVE.

nodes.label: Migration Status
nodes.semantics: Where each file stands in the pipeline (upload → extract → classify → validate → review → complete).
nodes.notes: Shown on the INTAKE root screen (AIO-MIG-ROOT-001, associated with INTAKE).

nodes.label: Match / Reconcile
nodes.notes: Open gap (prototype): the match decision is kept in the open page only.

nodes.label: Prebuilt Client
nodes.semantics: APPROVE MIGRATION creates a PREBUILT client office. PREBUILT is not ACTIVE.

nodes.label: Migration History
nodes.notes: Batches are listed today under ARCHIVE MIGRATION; a client-migration history view does not exist.

nodes.label: WORK
nodes.semantics: The central production workspace across ALL AIO service lines. Service lane navigation, cross-client filtering, client drill-down, active case access, status, blockers, deadlines, assignments where supported, and a route to the canonical client × workspace case. Replaces the old root FILING.

more_rules.rule: If an item drives daily production it belongs in WORK. If it is administration, a directory, a tool, settings or lower-frequency, it may live in MORE. Root-nav space is never a reason to move production into MORE.

exclusions.reason: Production. MORE keeps only the provider directory (MECHANIC NETWORK).
Entry work has its own root.
Production of the owning lane; the vault directory stays in MORE.

open_questions.question: Is the client hub (today MY OFFICE at /portal) the CLIENT OFFICE landing outside the seven roots, or should a hub be a destination?
open_questions.recommendation: Landing outside the roots (recorded as CLIENT_OFFICE.HUB, CANDIDATE_UNRESOLVED).

open_questions.question: The Brain COMPLIANCE workspace bundles operating authority + BOC-3 + safety, but the founder tree puts authority and BOC-3 under PERMITTING & AUTHORITIES. Split the workspace?
open_questions.recommendation: Split into AUTHORITIES (authority · BOC-3) and COMPLIANCE (safety) in the data sprint; until then the lane maps to the COMPLIANCE workspace.
open_questions.blocks: entitlement resolution for the PERMITTING & AUTHORITIES lane

open_questions.question: Vehicle management has a client destination but no staff lane. Keep it distributed (Dispatch → Trucks, Mechanic → Maintenance Status, Client 360) or add a lane?
